connector.name: Infomaniak MCP Agent
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial Infomaniak MCP - hosting, Node.js, mail, DNS, kDrive, SSL, VPS, domains. 81 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package infomaniak-mcp-agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mogacode-ma account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INFOMANIAK_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for api.infomaniak.com. Generate at https://manager.infomaniak.com/v3/api-token

env.name: INFOMANIAK_AUTH_MODE
env.description: Authentication mode for manager.infomaniak.com endpoints. 'auto' (default) reads Chrome cookies on demand. 'manual' uses INFOMANIAK_SASESSION+INFOMANIAK_XSRF_TOKEN. 'disabled' skips manager-private endpoints.
